# `theta_sketch_estimate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the estimated number of unique values
given the binary representation of a Datasketches ThetaSketch.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
theta_sketch_estimate(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- theta_sketch_estimate, example 1
> SELECT theta_sketch_estimate(theta_sketch_agg(col)) FROM VALUES (1), (1), (2), (2), (3) tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.1.0.
